title: Sum of Subarray Minimums

monster.name: Subarray Trough Fiend
monster.title: Accumulator of Valley Boundaries
monster.defeatQuote: Contribution of every minimum calculated modulo 10^9 + 7!

description: Given an array of integers `arr`, find the sum of `min(b)`, where `b` ranges over every (contiguous) subarray of `arr`. Since the answer may be large, return the answer modulo `10^9 + 7`.
solutionCode:
def sumSubarrayMins(arr: list[int]) -> int:
    MOD = 10**9 + 7
    n = len(arr)
    left = [0] * n
    right = [0] * n
    s1 = []
    for i in range(n):
        count = 1
        while s1 and s1[-1][0] > arr[i]:
            count += s1.pop()[1]
        s1.append((arr[i], count))
        left[i] = count
    s2 = []
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        count = 1
        while s2 and s2[-1][0] >= arr[i]:
            count += s2.pop()[1]
        s2.append((arr[i], count))
        right[i] = count
    ans = sum(arr[i] * left[i] * right[i] for i in range(n)) % MOD
    return ans

    n = len(arr)
    left = [0] * n
    right = [0] * n

    for i in range(n):
        count = 1
        while s1 and s1[-1][0] > arr[i]:
            count += s1.pop()[1]
        s1.append((arr[i], count))
        left[i] = count
    s2 = []
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        count = 1
        while s2 and s2[-1][0] >= arr[i]:
            count += s2.pop()[1]
        s2.append((arr[i], count))
        right[i] = count
    ans = sum(arr[i] * left[i] * right[i] for i in range(n)) % MOD
    return ans
